description: Providing assistance to the religious places affected by the disaster to clean and restore their activities
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2025-12-10 (Subject to Confirmation at the next Meeting)
decision_details_body: - The Government has decided that it would be appropriate to provide relief to all religious places that have been affected by the adverse weather conditions to clean them and restore their operations. Accordingly, the proposal made by the Hon. President in his capacity as the Minister of Finance, Planning and Economic Development to provide an allowance of Rs. 25,000/- for the cleaning and restoration of those religious places and to allocate necessary provisions for that purpose to the Ministry of Buddhasasana, Religious and Cultural Affairs, was approved by the Cabinet.
